note_en: No new candidate cleared the evidence bar. Futures were mixed, AMD's post-results reaction was sharply negative, and the verified proxy did not provide a complete pre-market quote set. All models remain empty rather than converting incomplete data into false precision.
note_zh: 没有新候选标的通过证据门槛。期指涨跌互现，AMD 财报后的市场反应明显偏弱，而且经核实的代理未提供完整盘前报价。三个模型均保持空候选，避免把不完整数据包装成虚假精确度。
